LESSON: RESPONSIBILITY VALUES

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian 4.5 By the end of the Sub strand, the learner ● Learners to read Luke 
Topic 4.6: Responsibility Values

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Responsibility Values. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. acquire the value of responsibility by taking care of the items they use at school school items at home 43

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. acquire the value of responsibility by taking care of the items they use at school school items at home 43
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to acquire the value of responsibility by taking care of the items they use at school school items at home 43. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Responsibility Values.
2. Explain Responsibility Values to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Responsibility Values.
4. Show that you can: acquire the value of responsibility by taking care of the items they use at school school items at home 43
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Responsibility Values. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Responsibility Values important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. acquire the value of responsibility by taking care of the items they use at school school items at home 43

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
